safety_and_limitations: Synthetic XLSX fixtures only; no real dedup template or real business workbook was used.
Comment marking and deletion were compared as plans; deletion operations were applied by the probe to a temporary copy, not through a production ExcelModifier capability.
The append test created a new candidate workbook. Existing-target modification was not executed and remains gated by registered ExcelModifier capability evidence.
Operation logging, failure recovery, XLS/XLSM/XLSB, Windows native release behavior, Kylin/UOS, glibc 2.28 and deb packaging were not validated.
